V01.label: Air temperature at 2 m
V01.note: Monthly mean air temperature. MERRA-2 reanalysis; this is not a direct satellite temperature observation.

TS.label: Earth skin temperature
TS.note: Monthly mean model surface skin temperature; distinct from air temperature at 2 m.

T2MDEW.label: Dew / frost point at 2 m
T2MDEW.note: Monthly mean dew/frost point, not observed precipitation.

PRECTOTCORR.label: Corrected precipitation rate
PRECTOTCORR.note: Monthly mean daily precipitation rate; not a monthly accumulation or a snowfall-only product.

SNODP.label: Snow depth
SNODP.note: Monthly mean model snow depth in centimetres; not snowfall rate, snow-cover fraction or snow water equivalent. Missing source cells stay transparent.

GWETTOP.label: Surface soil wetness
GWETTOP.note: Dimensionless model soil-wetness index (0–1), not volumetric water content. Undefined source cells, including masked ocean cells, stay transparent.

GWETROOT.label: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.note: Dimensionless model root-zone wetness index (0–1), not a water depth. Undefined source cells stay transparent.

RH2M.label: Relative humidity at 2 m
RH2M.note: Monthly mean relative humidity in percent, not specific humidity.

WS10M.label: Wind speed at 10 m
WS10M.note: Monthly mean scalar wind speed; this layer contains no wind-direction vectors.

PS.label: Surface pressure
PS.note: Monthly mean surface pressure in hPa, not sea-level pressure. Elevation affects this field.

V12.label: Surface sunlight
V12.note: Monthly mean downward shortwave irradiance from CERES SYN1deg, labelled in local solar time (LST); not daily energy in kWh/m².
